comparison.objective: Open a sealed cocktail shaker with a correctly placed strike, then set both tins upright; candidate screens dry ceramic media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold one tin, deliver a directional impact at the open-side seam, and lift the other tin versus controlled bulk flow, bimanual screen tilting, and bounded agitation to clear bridges.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seal break by the qualifying blow, tin separation, upright placement, release, and no dent/spill/fall. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no media loss or receiver contamination, no washer damage, and 3 s released support. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize spill or damage, impact-mediated seal breaking is not the candidate’s orientation-selective separation ability.
